QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] The Violent Forest
QuestInfo.0: You met Shadrion at #m300020000# and heard about the situation there.
QuestInfo.1: Help eliminate the furious Tree Rods and inform Athena Pierce of the South Forest situation.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated Tree Rods and notified Athena Pierce about the South Forest's situation.\nTurns out the forest is just as thick down there...

0.0: The South Forest is endless. I keep exploring...and it just keeps going. If we were to settle here, it would take years to cut down enough trees. Or we could just live in treehouses. Ha! Imagine that...\r\n#L0##bI see. I'll let Athena Pierce know.#l\n#k
0.1: Hey, before you go, could you give me a hand? The forest is crawling with Tree Rods, and they've kinda got me backed into a corner. I wanted Lohd to help me, but since he's not around...\r\n#L0##bLohd? Who's that?#l\n#k
0.2: He's the most powerful... Oh, come on, Kao. Don't act like you don't know who Lohd is. Anyway, are you willing to help?

yes.0: Okay, just take out some of the Tree Rods that show up in #m300020000# and #m300020100#. If you can eliminate #b#e100 Tree Rods#k#n and tell #eAthena Pierce#n about this place, we should be set.

1.0: How's the situation in South Forest?

yes.0: So, the forest just keeps going. Where can we live, where we'd be safe from all the dangers of this place?

npc.0: Eliminate 100 Tree Rods and report back to Athena Pierce.

mob.0: How's the situation in South Forest? I'm sure Shadrion could use some help. He's still young.
